$comment: D'Vine Spa treatment menu, transcribed from the owner's 'D'vine spa - galaxy UPDATED MENU.pdf' (September 2026). Source of truth for scripts/sync-menu.mjs. Prices in RWF. Waxing and nail durations are not printed on the menu; the values here are booking-slot estimates and can be edited in the dashboard. 'replaces' lists the names of the catalog entries the item supersedes, so the sync renames them in place (keeping their ids and booking history) instead of creating duplicates.
notes: When you need 15 more minutes of massage you add 10,000 RWF.
When you need 30 more minutes of massage you add 15,000 RWF.
